s: Din shatuy veshikkor litpilla ubo d' seipim: shata rebiit yayin bebat achat — al yitpallel ad sheyyasir yeno mealayv ap al pi sheyyaabor zeman hattepilla. Veim shata yoter, im hu yakol ledabber lipne hammelek — eno niqra shikkor ella shatuy utepillato tepilla im abar vehitpallel, veen tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel kesheyyapug yeno ap al pi shello abar adayin zeman tepilla. Veim eno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek — niqra shikkor. Veim abar vehitpallel — tepillato toeba ukeillu obed aboda zara, shenneemar: "vayyachshebeha eli leshikkora vego' vattomer vego' al titten et amateka lipne bat beliyyaal vego'", veen beliyyaal ella aboda zara, shenneemar: "yatzeu anashim bene beliyyaal miqqirbeka vayyaddichu vego'". Vetzarik hu lachazor ulehitpallel kesheyyasir yeno mealayv. Vaapillu abar zeman hattepilla — mashlim otah bizman tepilla shelleachareha, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"ch. Vedin qeriat shema ubirkoteha leinyan shikkor hu kedin tepilla, uleinyan shatuy yitbaer besiman qp"h. Abal shear berakot yakol lebarek ap al pi shehu shikkor:
Yayin shebbetok hasseuda eno meshakker. Veyesh omerim gam yayin shellipne hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"g:

Shena kol shehu mepiga et hayyayin, im lo shata ella rebiit. Abal im shata yoter merebiit — kol shekken sheshshena muetet meshakkarto. Abal shena harbeh — vadday mepigato. Veken derek mil mepiga et hayyayin, ben mehallek beraglayv ben rokeb al gabbe behema im lo shata ella rebiit. Abal im shata yoter merebiit — kol shekken shedderek toradto, im mehallek beraglayv. Abal im haya rakub sheen lo torach kol kak — apillu beyoter merebiit derek mepigato. Vehu sherakub g' milin. Umikkol maqom hakkol lepi rob hayyayin, sheim hirba lishtot meod — en derek g' milin mepigato:

Kol echad shehu shatuy — day lo lehamtin lepi shemmargish benapsho sheyyapig yeno. Velaken en nizharin akshav bayyenot shellanu shemmitpalelim ap al pi sheshshatu rebiit yayin veyoter, kevan sheanu margishim veyodeim bayyenot shellanu sheenam chazaqim. Vekol shekken im mitpalelim mittok hassiddur shebbeyadam, sheen chosheshin leshikrut meat. Veap beal peh en lachosh kol kak akshav millehitpallel keshehu shatuy im yaabor zeman hattepilla ad sheyyapig yeno, kevan sheakshav en mekavvenim kol kak battepilla. Abal shikkor legamre sheeno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek — tzarik lizzaher ap akshav kevan shettepillato toeba ukeillu obed aboda zara. Vetzarik lachazor ulehitpallel:
